nodes.label: README: application overview and local operation
nodes.rationale: Overview of three-company workflows and independent Accurate credentials supplied through the private Intranet environment. Docker no longer mounts the WMS environment file.

nodes.label: AGENTS: authoritative working boundaries
nodes.rationale: Defines authenticated endpoint enforcement, Accurate transport boundaries, audit/version requirements, and WMS isolation.

nodes.label: Accurate publication workflow and recovery
nodes.rationale: Current publication guidance includes September 30 SQ authorization and explicit SQ/PO/SO creation boundaries.

nodes.label: Accurate field matrix: September 24 research snapshot
nodes.rationale: Observational sample matrix and old API metadata; sample frequency is not proof of required business fields.

nodes.label: Accurate read-only research: September 24 snapshot
nodes.rationale: Documents bounded historical GET-only research, findings, limitations, normalization tests, and transport tests.

nodes.label: Storage and deployment documentation
nodes.rationale: Documents Neon/SQLite storage isolation and migrations; contains historical no-publication wording that conflicts with newer policy.

nodes.label: Verified GitHub-to-Vercel deployment guide
nodes.rationale: Documents main-only deployment after verification and a second build within Vercel.

nodes.label: Google Sign-In and whitelist guide
nodes.rationale: Documents the existing OAuth project, public Docker callback, separate Vercel configuration, whitelist and subject binding. Links to the Promax environment guide without any secret values.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions verification and production deployment
nodes.rationale: Workflow verifies changes with Node 24 and PostgreSQL 17, then deploys verified main.

nodes.label: Gastro Intranet: three-company commercial workspace
nodes.rationale: Workspace for PO, SQ/SO, item master proposals, and client master proposals across three Gastro companies.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 development API requirements
nodes.rationale: Relevant bundled Next.js documentation must be read before code changes because APIs and conventions may differ.

nodes.label: Local Node.js 24 runtime at localhost:3100
nodes.rationale: Local Node.js 24 startup uses npm ci and npm run dev. Google, APP_URL and five Accurate variables belong to the private Intranet environment. Docker passes its own variables directly.

nodes.label: Google OIDC authentication
nodes.rationale: Google scopes are only openid, email and profile. The backend validates issuer, audience, RS256 signature, expiration, nonce, one-use state and PKCE. Docker uses paired server-only client configuration and exact callback https://intranet.davay.space/api/auth/google/callback.

nodes.label: Admin-managed email whitelist bound to Google sub
nodes.rationale: Verified authoritative Google email must be whitelisted; identity binds to Google sub after first login.

nodes.label: Hashed 12-hour session with secured HTTP-only cookie
nodes.rationale: Role/company changes or deactivation revoke sessions; cookie is SameSite=Lax and Secure on HTTPS.

nodes.label: Server-enforced role, company, and ownership authorization
nodes.rationale: All data endpoints require authenticated users and server-side company/role/ownership checks.

nodes.label: Active company isolates commercial data and master identities
nodes.rationale: Staff and heads operate in permitted PT; Accurate master IDs must not be treated as equivalent across companies.

nodes.label: Staff sees own local drafts; department heads see team
nodes.rationale: Sales owns SQ drafts; importer owns PO drafts; department heads see corresponding team workflows.

nodes.label: Master admin manages users, roles, and allowed companies
nodes.rationale: Admin manages whitelist and role/PT permissions; master admin account cannot be changed or disabled through the feature.

nodes.label: Sales owner creates and publishes complete owned SQ
nodes.rationale: September 30 revision authorizes sales to publish complete owned SQ without head approval.

nodes.label: Sales head/admin selects SQ, approves and creates SO
nodes.rationale: Only sales head/admin selects Accurate SQ for SO; SO still needs internal approval and confirmation.

nodes.label: Importer owns local PO drafts
nodes.rationale: Importer drafts PO; importer head handles approval and item master proposals.

nodes.label: Importer head/admin approves and creates PO
nodes.rationale: PO requires internal approval then explicit create and confirmation by relevant head/admin.

nodes.label: Sales quotation: complete SQ may be created in Accurate
nodes.rationale: SQ is published before head selection for the SO workflow.

nodes.label: Sales order derived from explicitly selected Accurate SQ
nodes.rationale: SO derivative stores source SQ identity server-side and sends salesQuotationNumber per item; one active SO per SQ.

nodes.label: Purchase order after internal approval and confirmation
nodes.rationale: PO publication is an explicit final action after approval, with Accurate-generated number.

nodes.label: Local drafts with audit, optimistic version, and request keys
nodes.rationale: Draft mutations and audit share a transaction; row/version checks prevent stale changes and repeated concurrent creation.

nodes.label: SO internal notes remain local and audited
nodes.rationale: Publication mapper never includes internal SO notes in Accurate payload.

nodes.label: Dedicated create-only SQ/PO/SO publication service
nodes.rationale: Only publication service may invoke three save endpoints, without update IDs or retries; existing Accurate documents and masters are immutable.

nodes.label: Persisted publication reservation and audit transaction
nodes.rationale: Reservation, version checks, and audit precede send; only reservation winner calls Accurate with frozen payload.

nodes.label: PUBLISHING / UNCERTAIN / PUBLISHED publication locks
nodes.rationale: States block edits and resending; timeout/unclear outcome/process interruption do not allow automatic retry or unlock.

nodes.label: Read-only uncertain-outcome reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Checks Accurate number in same company against attempt marker, partner, lines, units, prices, quantity, discount, currency, rate, and total.

nodes.label: Allowlisted server-side Accurate GET transport
nodes.rationale: Reads use allowlisted GET transport; dedicated publication is the tightly scoped write exception.

nodes.label: Existing Accurate documents and master data remain read-only
nodes.rationale: No modification of existing Accurate documents or master data; proposed changes remain local.

nodes.label: Publication validates warehouses, tax, supported fields, and readback
nodes.rationale: PO/SO warehouse required per line; second/third taxes, non-100% taxable DPP and unsupported custom fields are blocked; result totals are read back.

nodes.label: One active Intranet SO per source SQ and frozen source lineage
nodes.rationale: Source with derivative is frozen; unpublished local SO can return to original SQ reference without creating a new Accurate SQ.

nodes.label: SQLite local development store under .data
nodes.rationale: Direct local runtime defaults to SQLite without DATABASE_URL; provided Docker Compose explicitly selects SQLite in a persistent named volume.

nodes.label: Shared Neon PostgreSQL with intranet_ object isolation
nodes.rationale: Shared WMS database is authorized but Intranet reads/writes only its own intranet_ tables, indexes, sequences, functions, and triggers.

nodes.label: Intranet user, session, OAuth-flow, and user-audit tables
nodes.rationale: intranet_users, intranet_sessions, intranet_oauth_flows and intranet_user_audit persist identity and whitelist state.

nodes.label: Intranet draft, sequence, request, and business-audit tables
nodes.rationale: intranet_drafts, intranet_draft_sequences, intranet_create_requests and intranet_draft_audit persist business workflows.

nodes.label: Lazy transactional migrations under advisory lock
nodes.rationale: intranet_schema_migrations records versions; gastro-intranet:schema advisory lock avoids parallel schema initialization; failed migrations roll back.

nodes.label: Append-only transactional business audit
nodes.rationale: Audit triggers reject update/delete/truncate; audit failure rolls back draft changes.

nodes.label: Sibling Gastro WMS: visual and integration reference only
nodes.rationale: WMS project must not be edited; WMS tables and shared-role authentication must not be copied or modified.

nodes.label: Server-only credentials excluded from Git and logs
nodes.rationale: Configuration uses server environment/.env.local; local INTRANET_WMS_ENV_FILE may import only needed Accurate variables.

nodes.label: Unit/API fixtures mock Accurate writes and avoid live trials
nodes.rationale: Tests must mock writes; ordinary fixtures do not contact Google/Accurate and no trial Accurate documents are allowed.

nodes.label: Explicit isolated PostgreSQL tests with temporary schemas
nodes.rationale: Only explicit INTRANET_TEST_DATABASE_URL activates temporary-schema tests with current_schema assertions and scoped cleanup.

nodes.label: CI installs lockfile, lints, typechecks, tests, builds
nodes.rationale: Node 24 verify job uses PostgreSQL 17 service; production build does not require service credentials.

nodes.label: Vercel gastro-intranet production hosting
nodes.rationale: Vercel builds exact verified GitHub commit using production environment; native automatic Git deployment is disabled.

nodes.label: Verified-main-only deployment gate
nodes.rationale: Vercel deployment requires verified main and the original ko-indra/gastro-intranet repository. The promax repository runs verification without deploying to the old Vercel project.

nodes.label: Historical read-only wording conflicts with current publication policy
nodes.rationale: Older deployment and field-matrix wording says no writes/SQ publication; current AGENTS, README and publication guide explicitly authorize guarded create-only SQ/PO/SO publication.

nodes.label: Historical bounded samples do not establish business requirements
nodes.rationale: September 24 sample was restricted GET-only research, not a full statistical audit or live-write validation; archived API metadata was not runtime-save tested.

nodes.label: Company-specific currency, tax/DPP, item, and source semantics
nodes.rationale: RSP samples include USD/EUR, Sarana taxable samples use 91.666667% DPP, and unsupported calculations must block copying instead of silently changing totals.

nodes.label: Gastro logo image with cyan and orange graphic areas, gray wordmark shapes, and a dark gray lower band
Promax repository with original Git history
nodes.rationale: Deployment is continued at the user-requested piemoul/gastro-intranet-promax repository, preserving history from ko-indra/gastro-intranet.

nodes.label: Docker environment and operation guide
nodes.rationale: Documents required variable names, independent Accurate environment, credential rotation, persistence and Docker verification without disclosing credential values.

nodes.label: Docker Desktop standalone Next.js service
nodes.rationale: App uses its own private environment, binds host loopback port 3100 and retains intranet_data. Compose explicitly clears the WMS environment-file path and has no WMS bind mount. Existing application image and backend are unchanged.

nodes.label: Persistent isolated Intranet SQLite volume
nodes.rationale: Compose selects SQLite in the existing persistent Intranet data volume, clears database test configuration, and does not mount WMS environment data.

nodes.label: Independent Accurate environment for three companies
nodes.rationale: Five Accurate variables now live in the private Intranet environment and are passed directly to Docker. Three company tokens and the shared signature key were copied once from WMS. WMS file changes cannot affect this runtime. Rotate credentials in Intranet and recreate the container.

nodes.label: Existing intranet.davay.space Cloudflare tunnel
nodes.rationale: The existing cloudflared service points to host.docker.internal port 3100. Public APP_URL and the Google callback must match that origin. Tunnel configuration is unchanged.

nodes.label: Paired server-only Google OAuth configuration
nodes.rationale: Google client ID and secret must come from the same Web application client, with exact callback https://intranet.davay.space/api/auth/google/callback. Private values stay outside Git and the image.

nodes.label: Local Graphify Studio service on port 3101
nodes.rationale: The nginx service serves a read-only locally generated Graphify Studio export, bound to host loopback only.

nodes.label: Project architecture and deployment map
nodes.rationale: Maps authenticated UI, authorization, stores, allowlisted Accurate reads and guarded publication. Docker now uses independent Intranet credentials without mounting the WMS environment.

nodes.label: Responsive UI review and reference evidence
nodes.rationale: Documents reference commits, surgical frontend changes, browser viewport checks, and preserved backend paths.

nodes.label: Simple centered Google login card
nodes.rationale: WMS login reference uses a centered single column, proportional Gastro logo and a maximum 448px white card. Existing OAuth endpoints, session checks and whitelist remain.

nodes.label: WMS and Portal responsive navigation shell
nodes.rationale: Aligns 288px desktop sidebar, 64px header, right mobile hamburger and right drawer limited to 352px or 88vw. Company selection uses the existing session-company handler.

nodes.label: Responsive dialog focus and scroll handling
nodes.rationale: Retains native modal focus handling, Escape/backdrop dismissal, focus restoration and body scroll lock. Entering desktop closes the drawer. The width below 1024px query removes a fractional viewport gap.

nodes.label: Labeled accessible list pagination
nodes.rationale: Adds previous and next labels, a polite page indicator and 44px targets. On narrow viewports the position has its own row. Page callbacks and disabled rules are unchanged.

nodes.label: Aligned mobile master and transaction cards
nodes.rationale: Uses consistent label/value columns, removes the inherited extra model margin and increases status legibility. Detail tables keep a local horizontal scroll region.

nodes.label: Surgical presentation changes preserve business rules
nodes.rationale: No changes to server, API, domain library, dependencies or lockfile. Local references remain read-only; backend permission and publication rules are preserved.

nodes.label: Browser viewport and interaction verification
nodes.rationale: Checks 320,390,768,1023,1024,1440px widths, login, navigation, company switching, paging, modal and unsaved form rendering. Docker reports 80 passed tests and two PostgreSQL skips.

nodes.label: Authenticated three-company Accurate read verification
nodes.rationale: Recorded 18 October 2026: 15 lists, 14 sample details and 15 rendered views across GGS, RSP and SRI. No trial transaction or saved local business draft was created.

nodes.label: Empty RSP quotation list is a valid read result
nodes.rationale: RSP SQ returns no records normally; no transaction is created to populate the empty state.

nodes.label: Graph memory of authenticated Accurate verification
nodes.rationale: Persists the verified read-only result, historical totals and source-node references for future graph queries.

nodes.label: Portable graph publication and local runtime artifacts
nodes.rationale: Published graph sources use repository-relative paths. Private environment, logs, runtime data, caches and generated graph artifacts are excluded from extraction. Runtime proof and full citation sidecars remain local.

nodes.label: Verified independent Accurate configuration
nodes.rationale: After separation the recreated container was healthy, the image and data volume were unchanged, WMS source was unchanged, and six GET-only item/customer checks succeeded across all three companies. No trial transaction was created.

nodes.label: Graphify excludes private and generated input
nodes.rationale: The project ignore rules exclude environment files, logs, private runtime data and derived graph artifacts from extraction. Non-secret graph memory may remain in the corpus.
